title: Dreaming Is Cheap
style: dream pop, glam metal, 132 BPM, mezzo-soprano vocals, electric guitar power chords, chiming guitar arpeggios, synth bass drone, analog polysynth pads, string ensemble swells, tom-heavy fills, gated reverb snare, tape saturation, plate reverb, stereo delay throws, four-on-the-floor kick, half-time prechorus, bittersweet longing, nocturnal uplift
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
A bus stop, two blocks from home,
Three more minutes to the regional train,
A couple of stations from where I come,
The high-speed commute taken with no pain.

Downtown reached in eight minutes,
Then a short walk or one metro stop,
All this without different tickets—
System in, system out, smooth like a drop.

[Chorus]
Just dreaming, dreaming is cheap.
Share dreams—can be the spark
Of a new urban beep (beep)
For us to leave the mark (mark).

[Verse 2]
The bus, the metro, also trams,
The regional train serving outskirts.
No need to join the traffic jams
Or be jammed in transit—that hurts.

High speed is not for the commute,
But large cities just need a few hubs
So urban transit can also route
Part of its load, like part of the subs.

[Chorus]
Just dreaming, dreaming is cheap.
Share dreams—can be the spark
Of a new urban beep (beep)
For us to leave the mark (mark).

[Bridge]
A cable into the mountains,
BRT to deploy where rails can’t reach,
City promenades with fountains,
Public plazas and parks in lieu of a beach.

[Outro / Final Chorus]
Share dreams—can be the spark
Of a new urban beep.
Keep dreaming, dreaming is cheap.
Keep dreaming, dreaming is the key.
